reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount helper that every planning site already calls and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the tolerance.

duplication.why: The approximate rule is written once in getPlannedAmount; call sites only pass their op.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing ranged-amount worst case, used by server and client alike.

scope.why: Focused on the rule and its callers, though it also changes display sites (schedule tables, mobile list, search filters) to show the planned rather than the nominal amount, which goes slightly beyond planning.

maintainability.why: One function owns missing/number/approx/range; the optional op means a new caller that omits it silently gets the exact value, and op was inserted before the inverse flag in the signature.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All amount sites call getScheduledAmount with their op; none reimplement it.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; getPlannedAmount is the single definition called by getScheduledAmount.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount/getPlannedAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts; forecast-schedules, schedule-template, schedules/app (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, api-models and the client components all pass op to it.
